item.title: 40th Toyota ShareLunker season is now underway
item.description: ATHENS — New Year’s Day 2026 launched the 40th season of the Toyota ShareLunker Program, another major milestone for Texas’ highly acclaimed and storied largemouth bass selective breeding and stocking program.

item.title: Indians battle DeSoto to close loss
item.description: DESOTO — The Waxahachie Runnin’ Indians were able to get one game in before Old Man Winter slammed the door shut over the weekend, as they battled the DeSoto Eagles to a 67-61 loss last Thursday to complete the first half of the District 11-6A basketball schedule.

item.title: WHS soccer teams romp past DeSoto
item.description: The Waxahachie Lady Indians bounced back from last week’s district-opening loss against Duncanville in a big way last Thursday night, cruising to an 8-0 road rout of DeSoto in a game that was moved up a day due to incoming winter weather.
